limits: Endpoint and lifecycle evidence does not verify every intermediate frame or calibrate physical FPS.
The scene was nearly uniform; this run does not establish optical field of view or color calibration. Earlier owner visual acceptance remains separate.
Full-sensor switching, arbitrary resize, wheel delivery and picker round-trip size retention were not repeated in this run.
Interaction observations include Windows App input delivery, state inspection and screenshot overhead; first-image observation is a loose upper bound, not exact startup latency.
operation_note: The owner opened the selection window. Root then used 200 ms held mouse clicks in Windows App; one physical connection was made. A previous zero-process observer timeout is preserved separately and is not a failed camera connection.
